newsitem.title: FRANCE: No policy moves at first French left cabinet mtg.
newsitem.headline: No policy moves at first French left cabinet mtg.

text.p: Catherine Trautmann, spokeswoman for France's new left wing government, said a cabinet meeting on Thursday did not take decisions on specific policy issues.

She told a news conference that the meeting was devoted to questions of government style and communication between ministers and that new Prime Minister Lionel Jospin would address the National Assembly after it resumes work on June 12.

"On specific dossiers it is a question for the ministers in charge," Trautmann said when asked by reporters if the cabinet had looked at specific policy issues such as the Renault plant closure in Vilvoorde, Belgium.
"The prime minister's intention is not to be rushed into anything," she added. Trautmann said the fine tuning of ministers' portfolios should be completed "by tomorrow evening".
